mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.battleid, c.chessname, c.hexid, c.q, c.r, -- 从hexgrid获取中心坐标 ST_X(h.center) as centerlng, ST_Y(h.center) as centerlat, -- 棋子类型信息 COALESCE(ct.name, c.type) as type, COALESCE(ct.pic_url) as chessurl, -- 属性（优先用棋子当前值，可用COALESCE取类型默认值） c.hp, c.maxhp, c.move, c.atk, c.range, c.moved, c.fired, c.player, c.createdat, c.updatedat FROM acgn0721_gis.tb_chessing c LEFT JOIN acgn0721_gis.tb_kesk_grid h ON c.q = h.q AND c.r = h.r AND h.bigmap = 1 LEFT JOIN acgn0721_gis.tb_chessing_pic ct ON c.type = ct.id WHERE c.battleid = #{id};

SELECT c.id, c.battleid, c.chessname, c.hexid, c.q, c.r, ST_X(h.center) as centerlng, ST_Y(h.center) as centerlat, COALESCE(ct.name, c.type) as type, COALESCE(ct.pic_url) as chessurl, c.hp, c.maxhp, c.move, c.atk, c.range, c.moved, c.fired, c.player, c.createdat, c.updatedat FROM acgn0721_gis.tb_chessing c LEFT JOIN acgn0721_gis.tb_kesk_grid h ON c.q = h.q AND c.r = h.r AND h.bigmap = 1 LEFT JOIN acgn0721_gis.tb_chessing_pic ct ON c.type = ct.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE acgn0721_gis.tb_chessing SET q = #{q}, r = #{r}, moved = #{moved}, updatedat = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE acgn0721_gis.tb_chessing SET hp = #{hp}, updatedat = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE acgn0721_gis.tb_chessing SET fired = #{fired}, updatedat = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE acgn0721_gis.tb_chessing SET moved = FALSE, fired = FALSE, updatedat = NOW() WHERE battleid = #{battleId} AND player = #{player} AND hp > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO acgn0721_gis.tb_chessing SELECT * FROM acgn0721_gis.tb_chessing_backup WHERE battleid = #{battleId}
mapper.select: SELECT q, r, id, elevation, eleclass, bigmap, ARRAY[ST_X(t.center), ST_Y(t.center)] AS center FROM acgn0721_gis.tb_kesk_grid t WHERE q = #{q} AND r = #{r} AND bigmap = 1
